name: Tetsu to Ra III -Touhou Douran: Megami Shittsui-
original_name: 鉄と裸III -東方動乱 女神失墜-
source:
Ashley Garland, an ancient great magician whose resurrection was announced to the world after the fall of the Holy Kingdom of Austin.

Once sealed away by a saint during a global war known as the Sealing War, he was dubbed the Demon King and once again plunged the world into chaos, eventually conquering even the Gareth Empire, the largest nation ruling the western part of the continent.

Having heard of the emergence of a culture not present a thousand years ago, Ashley became interested in the eastern part of the continent.
As he continues his research to change his own destiny, he believes that encounters and experiences with the unknown could hold the key to unlocking the future.

While he doesn't have excessive expectations, he believes there may be new discoveries to be made.

Though he knows those around him will likely try to stop him from heading there, Ashley is nonetheless excited about the prospect of heading to the eastern lands.

[MTLed from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1350333&gc=gc] Getchu[/url]]
translation:
阿什莉·加兰，古代大魔法师，在奥斯汀圣国灭亡后向世人宣布复活。

曾在一场名为封印战争的全球战争中被圣人封印，被封为魔王，再次让世界陷入混乱，最终甚至征服了统治大陆西部最大的国家加雷思帝国。

在听说一种一千年前不存在的文化的出现后，阿什利对这片大陆的东部产生了兴趣。
当他继续研究改变自己的命运时，他相信与未知的相遇和经历可能是开启未来的钥匙。

虽然他没有抱有过高的期望，但他相信可能会有新的发现。

尽管阿什利知道周围的人可能会试图阻止他前往那里，但他仍然对前往东部土地的前景感到兴奋。
